reason: The goal is to give the potato stems room, so the cargo mesh looks useful as a support for their growth.
expectation: I expect the mesh to make some kind of support for the potato plants, though I’m not sure how it will be fitted.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but the stated goal concerns the potato stems.

effect: The mesh supports the spreading potato stems, and the new goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the mesh fitted to the trough; I’m curious about the first harvest.
reason: Harvesting the ready lettuce is the only numbered action and should move me toward tasting it.
expectation: I expect the scissors to produce harvested lettuce, though it may still need preparation at the galley.

effect: The harvest yielded fresh leaves while leaving the lettuce bed growing. The galley is the next place to prepare them for tasting.
reaction: Leaving the small centre leaves was a satisfying detail; the harvest feels modest and ongoing.
reason: The galley is the only numbered option and seems like the natural place to prepare the lettuce for tasting.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the fresh lettuce at the galley, though I don't know exactly what the result will be.

effect: Washing and adding the lettuce to a meal completed the harvest goal and the chapter.
reaction: The green smell against the barren view was a vivid, satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the outer lettuce leaves while leaving the centre growing was the most worthwhile action; it connected the meal to an ongoing crop.

leastWorthwhile.text: The galley action was predictable because it was the only numbered option, though the resulting description made it feel worthwhile.

surprise.text: I was interested that the harvest left the small centre leaves in place so the bed could keep growing.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: the mesh supported the stems, the scissors harvested leaves, and the galley prepared them.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the potato crop develops and what happens next in the expedition.
